title: Calcium–phosphorus joint encoding beyond mineral products: exploratory independent-cycle albuminuria prediction
abstract: In exploratory NHANES2009–2010 to2015–2016 transfer, adding calcium–phosphorus tensor splines changed weighted log-UACR MSE from 0.797043 to 1.392968, delta +0.595926 (joint PSU-bootstrap95% [+0.003876,+2.143439]). The registered improvement criterion failed. This tests an encoding, not a new measured biomarker. Exploratory transfer, not untouched confirmation.
